column1: # Names of SparkyLinux KDE 2026.09's package set that have no package to install today, each with the reason read at its
# source (Debian's removal log, the suites that still have the source, the edition's own apt rules) and what took its
# place. A name missing from Debian testing is not thereby gone from the edition: when the reason is not a good one and

# SparkyLinux does not host the package, the edition carries it (Daniel, 2026-11-17), and its row goes when it is published. base-list.sh takes them out before it asks apt, and stops the build when a name listed here
# has a package again (then the row goes) or when a name without a package is not listed here (then it gets a row, or
# its repository is repaired). One name and one reason per line, separated by a tab. Read on 2026-11-17.
